# Department of Radio Communications and Video Technologies - TU Sofia

> Academic department at Technical University of Sofia specializing in radiocommunications, video technologies, signal processing, and telecommunications engineering.

The Department of Radio Communications and Video Technologies (Кафедра Радиокомуникации и видеотехнологии) is a core academic unit at TU Sofia offering undergraduate and graduate programs in communications engineering, signal processing, and video technology. The department conducts research in antennas, signal processing, medical imaging, and multidimensional image analysis.

## Key Topics

- Radio Communications
- Video Technology
- Signal Processing
- Telecommunications
- Antennas
- Medical Imaging
